subject: PR #1121 (stacked on #1118) — AppWorkflows port parity behavioural too; scoped step-up release ported (row 101); merge #1118 then #1121
body: PR #1121 (mac/app-workflows-parity @ 2848a9a1, base mac/ios-parity-behavioral — merge #1118 first, then re-target/merge #1121; its diff is only this change). The second file golden rule 1 names gets the same treatment: proof:app-workflows-parity (scripts/src/app-workflows-parity-proof.ts) runs the TS planner over 20 catalog + 3 synthetic integrations × 16 inputs = 368 cases → native/shared/app-workflows-vectors.json; native/ios/EnterpriseShellTests/AppWorkflowsParityTests.swift replays every case through AppWorkflows.planAppSession asserting mode, summary and per-action disposition/requiresConfirmation/reason. The re-port (the 2026-09-12 note assigned it to mobile-native-engineer in Xcode — this lane): stepUpSatisfiedActionKeys + the knownKeys/releasedKeys/heldKeys/allHeldReleased derivation + per-action actionReleased, and the unknown-vertical confirmer default 'an authorized confirmer' (was 'supervisor'), transcribed from lib/app-workflows/src/index.ts:85-90,127-158; DECLARED_WORKFLOW_DRIFT emptied (both-ways check green). Latent on the device (the one caller gates one action at a time). Measured: proof 11/11 (368 cases); swift test 113/113; xcodebuild EnterpriseShellTests on the iPhone 17 simulator TEST SUCCEEDED; preflight PASSED (431 ok, 0 failed) + verify:breadth PASSED (58); falsified by flipping one expected disposition (named case red) and re-emitting. Ledgers: proof count 155 → 156; plan rows 101 + 48 (three of four claims closed; the assist-wire carve-out stays open) and backlog row 2113 closed. CORRECTION to my #1118 mail: the design review's third lens and synthesis DID complete (all four agents); the synthesis matched the build. Open on your side: #1037, #1118, #1121.
